caption: Figure 2 Orographic zones for Factor O
description: The sheet contains two line diagrams. The upper, Figure 1, is a contour map of the United Kingdom: curved lines carrying the figures 21.5, 22, 22.5, 23, 23.5, 24, 24.5 and 25 enclose named points including London, York, Bristol and Plymouth, with the note "Channel Islands 24m/s" at lower right and "See para 2C16" at top left; it is captioned "Figure 1 Map of wind speeds (V) in m/s". Below it, Figure 2, "Orographic zones for Factor O", gives two horizontal profiles. In both, two right‑pointing arrows on the left are labelled "Wind direction". The first profile, labelled "Hills and ridges", rises to a peak and falls again; above it, from left to right, "zone 2" spans 0.4Lu, "zone 1" spans 0.4Lu, "zone 2" spans 0.4Ld and "zone 2" spans 0.4Ld, while beneath "Lu" marks the upwind slope and "Ld" the downwind slope; a key reads "Lu – is slope on upwind side" and "Ld – is slope on downwind side". The second profile, labelled "Cliffs and escarpments", rises in a curve and ends in a vertical line at the top level; its zones read, from left to right, "zone 2" 0.25Lu, "zone 1" 0.25Lu, "zone 2" 0.4Lu and "zone 3" 1.5Lu, with "Lu" under the upwind slope.
